routing.why_selected: The strict-LALR product repair had already been independently applied by another worker; the next executed blocker was a current-main composition gate failing only because two newly added Clay sources changed the denominator from 40 to 42.
duplicate_work_avoided: did not reimplement the already-landed RHS_ADD strict-LALR grammar repair
did not duplicate active UnifiedDB projection or runner-collision lanes

hypothesis: A composition gate can preserve the exact historical 36/40 frontier regression while also measuring an expanding current-main Clay corpus by separating source-universe identity from current-main descriptive coverage.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Freezing the historical source universe could hide real regressions caused by current-main changes to existing frontier files or newly added sources, creating a permanently green stale gate.

live_external_evidence.claim_used: strict=True is intended to surface parser conflicts rather than silently accepting them
LALR grammar conflicts are grammar-structure concerns; the repository diagnostic therefore preferred the smallest structure-preserving repair rather than weakening strictness

executed_negative_evidence.failure_cause: workflow gate hard-coded sources_total=40 and coverage_percent=90.0 while current main had added two Clay projection sources; all measured semantic/differential invariants above remained green

causal_source_growth_evidence.interpretation: The denominator changed because current main grew; this alone must not rewrite the meaning of the already established 36/40 frontier claim.

commits.change: corpus count semantics gate accepts an explicit --clay-dir while retaining the exact 429/464 selected-scope regression

current-main composition gate freezes the PR-head Clay source universe by Git tree, composes onto current main, measures frozen frontier and current-main corpus separately, and requires current full-corpus census consistency

anti_masking_properties: frontier source count must still be exactly 40
frontier parsed count must still be exactly 36
frontier coverage must still be exactly 90.0 percent
frontier unresolved snapshot must still be exactly 429 unique / 464 occurrences
all frozen source names must still exist in the composed current-main tree
current-main global census must equal current-main corpus unresolved counts
existing package, operator, call-surface and semantic differential gates remain mandatory
new current-main sources are reported explicitly as parsed or rejected rather than ignored

go_oob_experiment.purpose: Metamorphic denominator falsifier: add one deliberately unsupported synthetic Clay source only inside the isolated target run and require the frozen frontier semantic counts to remain identical while the synthetic source appears as an explicit rejection.

strong_counterhypothesis_test.test: If an existing frontier source changes incompatibly on current main, the frozen name-set still copies the composed bytes and the 36/40 plus 429/464 plus differential gates must turn red. New sources are separately visible and full-census consistency remains hard.
